name: Apollo 11 (Tranquility Base)
note: First crewed landing, 1969. Normal-ish sunrise/sunset reference.

name: Apollo 17 (Taurus-Littrow)
note: Last crewed landing, 1972. Second normal reference site.

name: Clavius crater
note: Where SOFIA detected water on the sunlit surface (2020). Crater centre.

name: Chang'e 4 (Von Karman crater)
note: First far-side landing, 2019. Earth never rises here: needs a relay satellite.

name: Chandrayaan-3 (Shiv Shakti Point)
note: India's landing, 2023. Southernmost landing at the time.

name: Mons Mouton (IM-2 target)
note: Intuitive Machines IM-2 target, 2025. Also near the planned VIPER area.

name: Malapert Massif
note: Artemis III candidate region. Tall massif facing Earth. Approximate region centre.

name: Haworth crater
note: Artemis III candidate region next to a permanently shadowed crater. Crater centre: real terrain keeps the floor dark.

name: Shackleton connecting ridge
note: One of the best-lit spots on the Moon, on the ridge to de Gerlache crater.
